policy: Two separate ladders, not one: the dedicated (VRAM) ladder runs dense models; the unified (CPU/Mac) ladder runs MoE only, because dense does not run well on unified memory. Both converge on Qwen 3.8 Flash Next at 64 GB — the only MoE rung on the dense side. Top of the unified ladder: DeepSeek V4.1 (1017), above Flash Next (pending). The Fit List IS the fallback chain: serve auto walks down the chain on OOM/timeout. Cross-cutting rules for every rung: (1) MTP on whenever available; (2) mind the power bill (kWh/hour) — IQ3_S is lossless, so do not push a heavier / higher-draw quant past it (32 GB and 48 GB both stay on GSQ-RCO @ IQ3_S).

8-11gb.note: dense ternary GGUF (Q2); prism-llama.cpp; MTP on

24-63gb.note: near-lossless; 262K at 24 GB; MTP on; power bill stays on IQ3_S (no heavier quant)

64gb+.note: MoE; both ladders converge on Flash Next; MTP on

unified.label: Ladder 2 — Unified (CPU / Apple Silicon, MoE only — no dense)

16-23gb.note: MoE, 3B active; faster than GSQ-RCO on CPU

64-127gb.note: MoE; both ladders converge on Flash Next; MTP on

128gb+.note: Top of the unified ladder — above Flash Next. 763B MoE (16B active); 1017 update, Strata engine. Pending: exact target-tier fit not yet validated (candidate).
